skills.name: Intoxicating Sip (小醉怡情)
skills.line: Don’t say I didn’t warn you.
skills.description: SP Hoshiguma Douji attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 120% and has a 40% base chance to inflict Confuse (lasts for 1 turn).

skills.name: Maximum Enjoyment (宾主尽欢)
skills.description: SP Hoshiguma Douji forces the non-summoned ally with the highest ATK to attack a selected target. Upon usage, dispels 1 debuff from all allies (prioritises control effects). ; (豪胆) : :'''Buff, Mark''': This effect is immediately consumed to dispel Confuse when inflicted with it.

upgrades.text: Has a 100% base chance to Seal the selected target, lasts for 2 turns.
Also dispels 2 buffs from the selected target.
Also forces 1 confused non-summoned enemy (prioritises the enemy with highest ATK) to attack the selected target.
Upon usage, grants all allies 豪胆, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Bottoms Up (饮过三巡)
skills.line: You’ll tell me everything if you’re drunk.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. SP Hoshiguma Douji creates a Banquet realm, lasts for 2 turns. While the realm is active, he is immune to Confuse and all other non-summoned entities have a 40% base chance of becoming inflicted with Confuse at the end of their turn, lasts for 1 turn, (limit of 3 times per entity before the start of his turn).

upgrades.text: While the realm is active, allies inflicted with Confuse gain 30% of damage reduction.
While the realm is active, when Confuse is removed from an ally, their move bar is increased by 25% (only triggers once per ally before the start of SP Hoshiguma Douji's turn).
While the realm is active, enemies inflicted with Confuse have their Crit DMG decreased by 40%, lasts for 2 turns.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically uses this skill at the start of battle.
